N : never; type Parser = <S extends string>(x: S) => Parse<S>; type Fixed = (x: "42") => 42; type Wrong = (x: "42") => string; interface Events<T> { value: { [K in keyof T as `on_${K & string}`]: T[K] } } type Native = Events<{ click: number; change: string }>; type Plain = { value: { on_click: number; on_change: string } };
